title: always-true-binary-op (clean-room semantics)

ground_truth.statement: After a falsy early return the left operand is truthy, but the AND result still depends on the right operand.

allowed.reason: The operand is explicitly mixed. This is a precision-policy diagnostic, not an assertion that its truthiness is unknown. PHP permits boolean conversion of mixed values; only the separate redundant-logical-operation is scored as the semantic criterion.

notes: The local source is a lead, not an oracle. Fixture and deterministic controls are re-derived from PHP semantics. Constant-condition diagnostics measure broad behavior, not a recommendation that every redundancy deserves a product warning. Measured with PHP 8.3.35, PHPStan 2.3.1, Psalm 6.20.0 and Mago 1.57.0. phpstan agrees with the scoped expectation; psalm agrees with the scoped expectation; mago agrees with the scoped expectation.
